channel.title: Carat Capital — The Trade Paper of the Jewelry World
channel.description: Prices, intelligence and analysis from every desk of the stone trade: diamonds, gold and metals, gemstones, watches, auctions, retail and technology.

item.title: HMRC seeks to wind up a Petra unit over £5.65m
item.description: The winding-up petition against Petra Diamonds UK Treasury, advertised in the London Gazette, is listed for a court hearing on 14 October. It lands a day after the board opened a strategic review including a possible sale of assets.

item.title: Gold adds $18.60 to $4,158.40 on the Monday board
item.description: Silver, platinum and palladium rose with it on Kitco's bid: silver $61.52, platinum $1,728.00, palladium $1,161.00. Palladium's intraday band was 6.03% of its own bid, the widest of the four.

item.title: Shuibei wholesale gold reads 1,061 yuan on 3 October
item.description: The Shenzhen district's real-time price sits 15.05% to 15.46% below three Chinese brand counters on their 2 October levels. 第一現場 supplied the figure, carried by HK01 on 4 October.

item.title: Caibai takes back its own gold at 15 yuan a gram
item.description: Without the shop's original receipt the same gold loses 6% of its weight and pays 25 yuan a gram. 时代周报 priced both routes at the Beijing flagship on 1 October.

item.title: Patek prices a women's Gondolo at $37,510 and $68,768
item.description: The two priced references in the new Gondolo Ladies First line share a 31 x 34.8 mm rose-gold case. JCK reported both from the brand's Milan exhibition, which runs to 18 October.

item.title: Eleven Indian exhibitors fill GJEPC's Sharjah pavilion
item.description: The India Pavilion sits inside the 58th Watch & Jewellery Show Middle East at Expo Centre Sharjah, which runs to 4 October. Organisers expect more than 66,000 visitors and over 1,000 trade buyers from 52 countries.

item.title: Five RAPI sizes sit below peaks set in late September
item.description: Every size on Rapaport's daily series is higher over the 30 days to 4 October. Every one is also below a peak set between 21 and 26 September, the 0.30-carat by 1.26%.

item.title: Gold sheds $144.40 on the week to close at $4,139.80
item.description: All four precious metals fell between the settled marks for 25 September and 2 October. Palladium lost the most in percentage terms at 7.91%, silver 6.07%, platinum 4.62%. The board is frozen until Monday.

item.title: De Beers takes 100% of Gahcho Kue, Canada's last mine
item.description: Mountain Province's release gives no cash consideration: its 49% goes in satisfaction of reclamation costs and every debt owed to De Beers. An option to buy back runs to 31 December 2029.

item.title: RAPI's sizes rise between 0.33% and 3.00% in a month
item.description: The window runs 2 September to 2 October on Rapaport's own daily series. Gahcho Kue realised 44.4% less a carat in its latest published quarter, a rough price the polished index does not carry.

item.title: Meta's Muse runs free, then $20 to $100 a month
item.description: The agent connects Shopify, Stripe, QuickBooks, Canva and Zoom to a retailer's Facebook and Instagram accounts. Meta published it on 29 September. Amazon has asked to be removed, Retail Dive reports.

item.title: Platinum sheds $34 to $1,691 on the 2 October close
item.description: Gold closed $4,139.80, silver $60.274 and palladium $1,152.00 on the same mark, all four lower. Kitco's own board puts the session changes smaller, measured against Thursday's close.

item.title: Chow Sang Sang's gold falls to 1,249 yuan, footfall doubles
item.description: Chow Tai Fook reads 1,255 yuan a gram and Lao Miao 1,252, each more than 10% under the 25 August high, on 21jingji's figures. Showroom gold in Zhengzhou quoted 934 yuan.

item.title: Boodles takes Argyle's brand, once over 90% of pink supply
item.description: Rio Tinto put no price on the transfer. Boodles also acquired the last remaining Argyle pink-diamond inventory, a suite of trademarks, the website and the digital marketing assets; the mine stopped producing on 3 November 2020.

item.title: Audemars Piguet launches 18 jewels, none of them a watch
item.description: Royal Oak Joaillerie opened at Paris Fashion Week with necklaces, earrings, cuffs and chokers in gold and titanium. No retail price was published. One cuff carries 506 diamonds, 19 amethyst cabochons and 16 black spinel cabochons.

item.title: Pandora opens $150 million Vietnam plant, capacity up 50%
item.description: The Ho Chi Minh City site opened 1 October, Pandora's first outside Thailand and its fourth worldwide, with room for 60 million pieces a year. It will employ 7,000 when fully operational.

item.title: Platinum adds $17.00 to $1,725.00 on the 1 October mark
item.description: Silver added $0.381 to $61.062 and gold $15.00 to $4,183.90 against the same mark. Palladium was exactly unchanged at $1,170.00, a second consecutive session on the same printed number, with a $40.00 quoted spread.

item.title: Palladium reads $1,170.00, 3.39% under the 30 September mark
item.description: Gold, silver and platinum also sit below Carat Capital's 30 September mark, by 0.54%, 0.39% and 0.23%. Palladium is the only one of the four also down on the board's own session change.

item.title: Pragnell ring makes $475,000 at Heritage, 90% above the high
item.description: The 22.09-carat fancy yellow carried a $250,000 high estimate. Heritage's 28 September Fall Fine Jewelry Signature sale took $7.6 million from 425 lots, and four of its top five beat their high estimates.

item.title: Gemfields revenue reaches $106.0m as net debt falls to $44.2m
item.description: The reviewed accounts for the six months to 30 June carry figures September's trading statement did not. EBITDA was $40.7m against a $4.9m loss a year earlier, and net asset value fell to $248.3m.

item.title: Three Chinese counters rise 12 to 14 yuan, Lao Miao flat
item.description: Lao Feng Xiang read 1,262 yuan on 30 September, Chow Tai Fook 1,259 and Chow Sang Sang 1,257. Lao Miao held at 1,242, and the three with a published base sit 10.71% to 11.73% below the 25 August high.

item.title: Two Pucci Rolexes carry estimates above CHF 1m at Phillips
item.description: Sixteen watches from Pucci Papaleo's 70-piece Rolex collection go into the Geneva Watch Auction XXIV on 7 and 8 November. A Stelline Ref. 6062 is estimated at CHF 600,000 to 1,200,000.

item.title: Four Rolex Daytonas make £37.3m at Phillips in London
item.description: The one-off Cosmograph Daytonas sold individually on 28 September, raising $49.5m for the Federer Foundation and Re:wild. The set was conceived as a private sale at about $4.9m.

item.title: Tamil Nadu orders 441,667 gold rings at one paisa above gold
item.description: Joy Alukkas won the lowest bid for processing, insurance, transport and hallmarking, and took 70% of a first-phase order of 1,28,499 rings. The state has earmarked Rs 755.83 crore a year.

item.title: RAPI's 1-carat adds 0.43% in a month, the 0.30-carat 3.3%
item.description: Rapaport's published daily series runs 30 August to 30 September for five sizes. The benchmark one-carat held inside a 0.61% band across the window, the narrowest of the five.

item.title: Chow Sang Sang gold reads 1,245 yuan, 11.6% off 25 August
item.description: Three Chinese brand counters read between 1,242 and 1,246 yuan a gram on 29 September, each down 163 to 165 yuan since late August. Spot gold has since risen to $4,191.60.

item.title: 23.34-carat yellow diamond tops Phillips Hong Kong at HKD 4.3m
item.description: The fancy-intense-yellow VVS1 ring sold in line with its high estimate on 29 September. Phillips took HKD 37.2 million ($4.7 million) from 91 lots; two of the top five missed their low estimates.

item.title: Oak and Luna prices its Arad capsule from $50 to $180
item.description: The 24-piece styling kit tops out at panther-shape drop earrings in gold-plated brass. Cocktail rings run $120 in silver and $140 in gold tone, JCK reports, with agate, lapis and aventurine as the stones.

item.title: Gold's fix falls $116.50 to $4,144.55, lowest since 4 August
item.description: Silver's fix fell 5.67% to $61.33 and platinum's 2.09% to $1,731.85, both the lowest since early August. Spot gold read $4,144.10 on the Kitco bid at press time, $30 higher on the session.

item.title: 16.01-carat Van Cleef ring leads Sotheby's Paris at EUR 400,000
item.description: The rectangular step-cut J-colour, VS2-clarity stone heads a Fine Jewelry sale of more than 270 lots on 8 October. Cartier, Boucheron and Chopard pieces are also catalogued, Sotheby's own site shows.
